scope: CPU scoring adapter with 100 synthetic 128x128 rendered images and a constant visible-mask test double; no Habitat, CUDA renderer, reconstruction, or GPU timing
interpretation: The CPU profiler proves eliminated copies and scalar extraction calls. Timings are narrow CPU fixture timings on a shared server, with variation; they do not establish full-pipeline or GPU speed or reconstruction quality. GPU bounds are now host metadata in the actual planner; GPU effect remains unmeasured.
